reviews.comment: This class is extremely interesting if you like history and travelling, but definitely not an easy creative arts credit. I'm not an arch major, so I definitely had to study for his exams (they are not the easiest). Dr. Glowacki is passionate about what he teaches, and lectures are entertaining. Not an easy class, but worth it if you want to learn.

While my major is not related to architecture or history, I took the ARCH249 course to fulfill my university art credit. I was pleasantly surprised that Professor Glowacki's course was easy, engaging, and meaningful. Each lecture was highly enjoyable and I felt like I was watching a documentary.  I wish he taught another history class I could take!

Professor Glowacki was one of the best collegiate professors I have had. He is so passionate about the course content, which in turn makes retaining the information easy and enjoyable. His classes require active listening during lectures and lots of reading assignments outside of class, but I would take anything taught by him again in a heartbeat.

I loved Glowacki's 249 class! I took it first semester of my architecture degree and found that he was an amazing introduction into that. He has a background in archaeology, so his lectures include some of his research and little tid bits I liked. He genuinely cares about his students and the content. This shows in his lectures. I highly recommend!

I took him twice one for 249, which I got a B in, and another for 443. Way smaller class and really got to know him. He's an amazing teacher, very entertaining, understanding, and just cool. Highly recommend 443 if you're looking for an extra history credit. He's what inspired me to do an architectural history minor.

Lectures are very interesting and passionate, and often include little details that would otherwise be missed since attendance is not mandatory.

Three fairly easy and short writing assignments, and three memorization heavy exams. No cumulative final. 

One of the few professors who seems to really enjoy what they teach, would recommend to anyone.

It's very much like an AP history class where you just have to memorize the lectures and monuments thrown at you. It's very fast paced and as long as you know how to study you should be good. He is very knowledgeable at what he lectures about. I recommend taking advantage of the weekly study modules in Canvas for study prep.

Genuinely cares about what he is teaching, which makes the lectures interesting and inspiring. He has study slides for each test, which are very helpful since you do need to memorize names. I had a few issues with how one of the TAs graded a paper and brought it to him. He regraded it promptly and explained everything. I highly recommend him!

The topic is very interesting, I do however recommend taking this class in the afternoon if possible because it will put you to sleep. He is very informative and explains fairly well. Don't slack off although it might be easy to. There are 3 core assignments and exams so give effort because your homework won't count for much of your grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is very interested in what he is talking about, which in turn makes his information heavy lectures entertaining. The class is relatively easy but you will need to do some very heavy studying if history classes and memorization isn't your strong suit. He does post study guides every week and study slides before every test to aid you in studying.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Glowacki is very knowledgeable about architecture and ancient history. His lectures are quite interesting if you're willing to listen. There were three tests and three core writing assignments. Each core assignment got progressively easier as expectations were more clearly stated. If you can cram and review the slides, you'll be fine.

Great Prof, he is very passionate about his class, and he talks a lot during class. The exams often include material that he discusses in class but isn't included on the lecture slides, so pay attention.
Great lectures, great prof. He posts study guides for all the exams every week and they're pretty easy, just memorize.Also he's a great guy.

Literally the best. I took ARCH as my art credit. Gives reviews for exams. Lectures are not boring. Weekly homework assignments are easy if you read the textbook. LOVED his class. Attendance is not mandatory bujt sometimes he says stuff in lectures you would want to know on exam.

One of the best professor I have ever taken. Loves his work. Has only a few exams that are easy if you review all the notes. Always gives clear instructions on work and exams. Very knowledgeable. Weekly homework but it is simple if you read the textbook. I will definitely take another one of his classes.

important to take detailed notes! a tablet & stylus is good for lectures so u can annotate slides, important to work with peers on study guides bc it's a lot of info, he has a relaxing voice so if u go to class tired ur probably gonna fall asleep, always ready to answer questions and loves discussion, clear criteria on 3 papers, very passionate
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: really enjoyed the lectures it is obvious he really enjoys teaching attendance is not mandatory but you miss at lot of information if you do not attend

Dr.Glowacki's lectures are very entertaining if you care for architectural history, exams are mainly based on what he says during lectures, he posts notes and although attendance isn't necessary, you should still make an effort to go in order to do well. The exams aren't difficult and he posts a study guide.

Glowacki is a great professor, he has a clear passion for the subjects he teaches. He was always willing to help and would talk as long as you let him. I could never figure out his exams, and was always caught offgaurd, which is definitely my fault. Take notes and you should be fine.
Bad professor

One of my favorite classes I've taken at A&M. Wasn't sure if I'd enjoy architecture, but lectures were engaging and interesting and material wasn't overwhelming at all. Minimal studying and effort make this class a very attainable A. Professor Glowacki is one of the best profs at A&M undoubtedly.

He was very informed and very interested in Architecture in general, with him having a heightened insight into each building. His lectures were very informative but sometimes would bore with the length. His tests are made from his lectures though so it's necessary to still go.

Professor Glowacki is probably my favorite professor I have taken so far at TAMU. His lectures are engaging and most of his test questions come from the lectures. He is an architectural archeologist and gives interesting insight into the buildings of antiquity. If you enjoy history, you will enjoy this course.
Just listen to his lectures in order to be prepared for the test, all other homework is really easy.

Prof. Glowacki is an archeologist who has been to several of the sites that he covers in class. He has an amazing story to tell about each and every site and lectures are dense with awesome material and information. He is very kind and loves to hear from his students. Amazing professor and highly recommend taking him if you can.

Professor Glowacki is a great prof. His lectures are very interesting and he really cares about the arch. We had 3 exams but all were quite easy with only a day of studying. We had weekly readings but they are completion graded and the 3 "core assignments" making up 30% were also easy grades. I took it as a core curriculum class and really liked it
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: really good professor, I wouldn't say this class is an easy A but it is definitely doable. I got A's on all the core assignments but got B's on the tests so i ended up with an 89.

I love Prof. Glowacki! His lectures are easy to follow along with, and he provides so many resources to help you do well. If you do the work given, pay attention in class, and use the resources he gives you, you will have no problem excelling in his class!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Honestly the class was super interesting, just a lot harder than I feel it should have been. I took it as a blowoff and ended up with a B.
GREAT PROFESSOR! Very knowledgeable and passionate. Homework and other assignments were strongly correlated to the material on exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Glowaki is very passionate about what he teaches and his lectures are interesting. Tests were harder than I thought, but if you're good with flashcards and memorizing facts then you should be good. I don't think the weekly readings are necessary as long as you're familiar with the monuments on the study guide. His exam study materials are helpful

This class wasn't too bad, I just found his lectures to be boring so I didn't really go. The tests were hard for me because they were really long, and covered a lot of material. Other than that, the class was fine. Just make sure you participate /pay attention.

Prof. Glowacki is obviously very invested in his practice; however, some of the content can be a bit boring at times, especially near the end of the semester. Study the slides prior to the exam and you should do fine. Pay attention during the lectures and make notes that are visually-oriented.

I loved this class. As an engineering major, I took this class as a core credit and do not regret it. His lectures are long, but they are dense with amazing knowledge from someone who has first-hand experience with what we were taught. My biggest study tip would be to study the Review Slides before the exam and fill in relevant historical context.

I thought this class would be an easy A but it turned to have a lot of work. It is very test heavy and there are a lot of homework assignments. I had an A but it dropped to a B because of the paper. He has 2 projects and 3 tests but overall it was an okay experience.
The lectures are very interesting and enjoyable. Readings are weekly but not extremely time-consuming. Tests are weighted heavily so do not skimp on studying the material.

There is a lot of homework, the tests are not open note if you take this class in person.  Prof Glowacki is an archeologist with no background in architecture, so his lectures are very heavy on culture/background and the tests are more about architectural aspects.  He barely talks about the architectural stuff so you have to dig for it to do well.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He gives great lectures and I would recommend him for anyone taking ARCH-249

He was very monotonous and boring, especially if you had him in the morning, as I did. Go to the lectures though, because he talks about things not included in the slides. Be prepared for a lot of writing assignments. Also, he assigns lots of reading each week, so don't get behind or you won't be able to catch up.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Easily one of my favorite professors at A&M. His lectures are so incredibly informative and amazing to listen to, his assignments are super easy and graded well, and he also gives out extra credit for those who wish to obtain it. He also has a nice spunk to how he lectures, and I really appreciate that.

Fantastic prof. Lectures are super interesting even if you're not an arch major. You can tell he really cares about the material and does a great job teaching it. He gives a lot of readings but I never read them and was fine. Exams were online and open note with good study guides. Weekly discussion posts and textbook questions. Overall easy A

I loved this class! Dr. Glowacki is super passionate about architecture and it makes the lectures really interesting. I learned a lot about both architecture and history. This class is a great option for an arts credit!

Awesome professor. He gave great feedback on discussion posts. He was engaged with his students. He had clear grading criteria and was entertaining in his lectures. I learned so much from this course. He is a super understanding and caring professor. I wish I was in architecture purely so I could take more of his courses.

Honestly if I liked architecture, the class would have been quite enjoyable. But for anyone not actually interested in history of architecture, the class is an easy A if you just show up and do all your work on time. In edition, Dr. Glowacki is a super friendly and overall nice guy and will try and help if you ask.

Professor Glowacki is an incredible professor with a true passion for what he teaches. He has a lot of experience and tells many stories of all the places he has visited. Lectures may be long, but if you pay attention and take notes, the tests wont be hard. The tests were multiple choice and online too.

This class was not extremely hard but it was more work than I thought. He's a great prof and very nice, but you definitely need to study for the tests. There is a lot of material covered, so make sure you know it very well before. It's also easy to forget due dates for hw so set reminders for sure.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The material is boring, but Glowacki is so passionate abt what he teaches so it makes you want to learn. His tests are open note, the homeworks are easy, and an easy grader. He is an easy A if you don't slack or at least study the week of the test. He gives study guides and flashcard materials. Great prof overall.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Glowacki is a great lecturer and really knows what he's talking about. He's pretty fair with assignments and won't try to kill you with the workload. Just make sure that you stay on top of things and you'll be fine. He makes exams open note so you have no excuse for not doing well.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Glowacki is very knowledgeable and passionate about what he teaches. Sometimes he goes really in depth on a subject which bores me a bit because I'm not as passionate about architecture as he is. Tests were open note/book, and there were 3 projects. He grades fair. One of the nicest professors I've met.

Lectures are interesting and he really knows the information. He is very passionate about architecture and that makes the lectures fun. Definitely read the book in order to do well on the tests. Not a hard A if you do the work.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Glowacki is a solid professor. However, he grades very few things throughout the semester. This leaves little room for error so you always gotta stay on top of stuff in class. He knows what he is doing and there is a reasonable amount of work associated with the class. Overall, good professor.

I like Dr. Glowacki as a person. As a professor it was very difficult to know what was going to be important on the test or not. It took me until the very last exam, not kidding, to figure out how to effectively study the "correct" material for his lectures. His TA's grade the exams and I swear sometimes they make mistakes so go in to go over test.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: there are 3 tests and three 'papers'. the papers aren't always essays. they can be powerpoints or worksheets or posters. Glowacki covers everything you need to know in his lectures. He used powerpoints that contain key information for the tests. homework is easy and is mostly reading-based .
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Glowacki is an incredible prof. Classes consist of lectures with an occasional day to review the written assignments before their due dates. Tests are over the lectures, and if you attend class, you will easily pass this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: GREAT professor. Has all the readings online so you don't necessarily need the textbook, but make sure to read! His tests are all essay so you need to have a extensive knowledge of the terms he goes over in class. I would definitely take another class taught by him.

Prof Glowacki is very kind, can crack jokes, and passionate about his course. There is 3 tests (including the final) and 3 papers so getting an A is very do-able. With the papers he doesn't make it clear on what the grading rubric was, but he seems to grade fair. Overall great Professor!!

Excellent professor who clearly cares about his subject. There are 3 papers, and 3 tests that are based on identification of monuments and their related facts. Posts lecture slides online after each lecture. Papers are not clearly graded, but generally pretty easy. Overall, memorization is key for an A but not to difficult with some effort.
reviews.ratingTags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Glowacki is a very passionate person and really cares about his class. His test are visual, which means taking the test based off of pictures on the board. There are 3 test (20% each), and three papers (10%). There is also reading assignments online (1% each), but they are easy. Strong professor and would take him again.

Super interesting class and passionate prof. The tests are all memorization so if you suck at that (like me) you will struggle. Review slides and take notes in class and you should be gucci for the tests (again unless you are not good at memorizing stuff).

He's a nice guy and is definitely enthusiastic about the material. However, he makes a subject that could've been interesting overly complicated and detailed. How he graded papers wasn't clear at all, and he would give wrong marks on answers straight from the book. Lectures were also a drag because he makes it so detailed. Don't take this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: 3 tests 3 essays. The essays are easy as long as you pay attention to the lectures he does over the topics he basically gives you the answers for the essay.  Make sure you study for the tests! They are multiple choice, but you have to know the buildings and their main details. Overall a very good teacher, he knows his stuff!
reviews.ratingTags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Really good prof. Is very dedicated to his major and tries to engage students to learn. However, if you're trying for an easy class, this isn't the class. 3 essays worth 10%, 2 tests and a final, detailed, worth 20%, and 10 easy homework assignments 1% each. Offers 2 extra homework assignments to up your average 2 points. Post slides online.

He has 3 papers in a semester, and not once was it very clear how he graded them. His tests are far more detailed than you would expect, especially if you were to only study the books. His lectures are very long and boring, and very detailed. He made an easy class very difficult by getting too into the material. If you can, take Caffey instead.

I took ARCH 249 as a creative arts credit thinking it would be an easy A, however it definitely was not. Prof. Glowacki is very passionate about architecture, however if you aren't his lectures can drag. His exams have a lot of material on them and take a lot of preparation to do well. He gives 3 essays which do help take weight from the exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very, VERY, thorough professor. Dr. Glowacki is an expert in Architectural history and his passion for the subject flows in each lecture. You will be challenged greatly in this class but it is to your benefit as it will establish a baseline that will carry you thru the rest of your college career. EXCELLENT professor, tough grader. LOVE THIS CLASS.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: TAKE THIS PROF! He has so much enthusiasm for the class, so I really enjoyed learning. It's obvious that he loves what he does. Tests are pretty easy, but you must know the monuments by looking at pictures of them and the architectural terms, so I studied diligently. I loved this class, and I definitely recommend Prof. Glowacki!!!
